# Little Hands (ليتل هاندز)

> Handmade clocks, natural wax candles and wax scent pouches, made by one maker in Al Khobar,
> Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia. Custom orders, wedding and occasion favours, and small
> hands-on workshops. Orders and sign-ups are taken by message.

## Pieces
- Aqua resin table clock: Hand-poured in two layers: aqua at the back, clear at the front with dried red gypsophila and gold leaf. Gold-rimmed face with Roman numerals.
- Clear resin flower clock: Clear resin over a champagne glitter layer, filled with pressed pink blossoms, yellow daisies, lavender and gold flakes.
- Natural wax candle: Hand-poured into a glass jar. Ask which scents are ready this month.
- Wax scent pouch: Scented wax set with dried flowers, for wardrobes, drawers and the car.
- Wedding and occasion favours: Mini candles or scent pouches in your colours, with names or a date, made in quantity.
- Gift box: A candle, a scent pouch and a handwritten card, wrapped and ready to give.

## Workshops
- Candle pouring: Pour, scent and decorate your own natural wax candle, then take it home. All materials included. Runs once 4 people sign up.
- Wax scent pouches: Press dried flowers into scented wax and make two pouches to keep or give away. Runs once 4 people sign up.
- Private classes for groups of four or more.

## Where
Al Khobar, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia. Pickup or delivery is arranged when you order.
